name: ui/address-share-card
title: AddressShareCard
summary: An address to hand to someone: a QR code that opens the share link, the code chip, the link written out, and the directions in words. The QR is drawn server-side as one SVG path in currentColor.

props.name: url
props.description: The share link the QR encodes, exactly.

props.name: directions
props.description: How to find the entrance, in words.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: The QR code encodes `url` (error correction M, a four-module quiet zone) and is one <svg role="img"> whose aria-label names the link it opens.
The QR is drawn in currentColor on the card, so it needs no image request, no script and no literal colour.
The link is also written out (without its scheme) as a real link, because a QR code is not readable by everyone.
The code is shown with `address-code`, without its link (the card's own link opens the same place).
Title and directions render only when given.

props.title: Tendai's stall
props.directions: Green gate with the bee sign, opposite the bus rank.

keyboard: Tab to the link; Enter follows it.
focus: The --ring focus ring on the link.
aria: The QR image's aria-label is "QR code that opens <url>"; the same link is in the text.

theming.brandOverlay: Only --primary (the link) and --ring change with the brand; the QR is the foreground colour.

noJs.without: Everything: the QR is computed when the page is rendered.

responsive: The card is at most max-w-sm and fills a narrower container; the link breaks anywhere rather than overflowing.
contract:
contract
  slot is "address-share-card"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/address-share-card"
  uses address-code
  a "kweli.mukoko.com/a/NYU-7K2Q" min_height 44
  when default shows h3 "Tendai's stall"
  when default shows p "Green gate with the bee sign"
end

checks.say: One QR image, named for its link.
The QR names what it opens.
The QR is one path in currentColor.
The link is written out and opens the address.
The code chip carries the code, with no second link.
No title or directions when none are given.

gaps: In a dark theme the QR is light modules on a dark card (an inverted code). Current iOS and Android camera apps read inverted codes; some older scanners do not. A light QR plate needs a surface token that stays light in every theme, which Mzizi does not define yet.
